Background: Trident Arcadia Control (TAC) is a national defense authority running critical maritime and coastal control systems. They are evaluating Redwood Private for an air-gapped deployment to replace several legacy rule-based assistants and to run closed-network incident response tooling.

Summary of requirements (from CTO & SecOps call):
- Must operate fully air-gapped; R/W to removable media controlled by HSM and FIPS-validated keys.
- Strict data residency: all models and logs must remain on-prem, retention configurable per regulatory tag.
- Support for model isolation: customer wants ability to host multiple model variants per enclave and automatic fallback to quantized local models if primary model fails.
- Latency SLO: 95th pct < 120ms for short-chat/alert summarization path; batch embeddings throughput for nightly ingest ~1M docs/day.
- Strong audit trail (immutable logs) and integration with existing SIEM (Splunk) and ticketing (JIRA).
- Compliance checklist: CMMC L3, ITAR, FedRAMP-equivalent internal controls.
